items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 18:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the building of Malchut? At the time that the Nukva has only the aspect of VAK without a head, namely that she lacks the aspect of the NHY of the vessels and the GAR of the lights, then she has no building of her own at all, and she is discerned as clinging entirely to ZA, in the secret of “and her back is within”. For the principal discernment of the Nukva is in her NHY, which are the aspect of the vessels of reception for revealed Hassadim with the illumination of Hochma. And as long as she has no NHY of vessels at all, she is entirely attached to ZA and does not rise at all in name. But only at the time that she attains the Mochin of the GAR of Ima, from the stature of AB of the Mazal, which raises her fallen AHP and completes her NHY of vessels — then a building of a Partzuf of her own is made for her, called “the building of Malchut”, for after she has the NHY of vessels, she is discerned by a name of her own, and by this she is sawn off from ZA, her husband. As is known. (Item 99).
